title: 巴克莱印度CEO：IPO火热背后，三大引擎驱动资本需求
speaker: Pramod Kumar

segments.en: Talk us. I mean, we had the likes of Blackstone saying, you know, this is one of the most liquid markets outside of the US right now. So easy again, IPO done.
segments.zh: 聊聊吧。黑石等机构说，这是美国以外流动性最好的市场之一。IPO很容易完成。

segments.en: In India, what do you think is driving this momentum that we're seeing in the IPO market now? Look, India continues to be growing pretty fast, right, the 7% plus GDP growth.
segments.zh: 印度IPO市场这股势头由什么驱动？印度经济持续快速增长，GDP增速超过7%。

segments.en: India's always had very strong equity markets, you know, both retail as well as we've seen growing interest of domestic institution. And there are so many new sort of startups, right?
segments.zh: 印度权益市场一直很强，散户和国内机构兴趣都在增长。还有很多新兴初创企业。

segments.en: So you see Fintech, consumer tech, large infrastructure. All of those are really driving the need for a race capital. There's been a lot of financial investors capital, sponsor capital that's gone into supporting the company's capital raising plans. So they're also looking to exit through IPOs and subsequently through block.
segments.zh: 金融科技、消费科技、大型基建都在推动资本需求。大量财务投资者和发起人资本支持企业融资计划，也寻求通过IPO和后续大宗交易退出。
